KAZAR / PRIVACY

Privacy

How project enquiry information is handled.

01

Information you provide

Name, email, project stage and project brief; optional contact and project details. Drawings are requested only when relevant to the next step.

02

Purpose and access

The proposed website workflow uses information to review and respond to the enquiry and support an agreed engagement. Access is limited to authorised project and enquiry personnel.

03

Privacy notice for publication

Owner confirmation required before launch: legal controller and privacy contact; lawful processing basis; service providers and hosting locations; retention schedule; rights and request process; international transfers; cookies and analytics actually enabled.

04

Your project documents

Do not include confidential third-party information unless you are authorised to share it. Private intake and uploaded documents must use controlled access.
